description: TransWorldNG is a traffic simulation research codebase published by SAC Labs. It uses a heterogeneous graph and learned agent behaviour to represent traffic scenes and interactions, with scripts for generating examples through SUMO and running the trained simulation workflow. Users supply a road network, traffic scenarios and training or model parameters; outputs are simulated vehicle trajectories or traffic states for the configured network and period. Geographic coverage is a user-defined test area. The repository offers free use under Unlicense terms and gives dependency and run instructions. A limitation is that learned driving behaviour depends on the training cases, and the public README does not demonstrate calibration for a real city's demand or safety outcomes. TransWorldNG can support research comparisons of traffic control or network disruptions, not operational traffic forecasts without validation. The catalogue's model-sumo is the distinct simulator used to prepare some example data. No road network, trained weights or package was downloaded.
inputs: Road network and generated traffic scenarios
name: TransWorldNG learned traffic simulator
